svg.title: CAO-DF - Activity Diagram: the decision rule

g.text: CAO-DF - Activity Diagram: the decision rule
Input: workload features (orders, files, shuffle fraction),
expected runs N, cost proxy (P1 / P2), noise floor delta = 0.10
Load reference table of measured study workloads
(saving s and one-time cost ratio r = Copt / Crun_static
Scale features by their range over the study workloads
TC(Nothing) = N (costs in units of one static run)
A1 Tune: find nearest study workload(s)
A2 Compact: find nearest study workload(s)
Choose the option with the lowest TC
then run with the best one
then run on the compacted files
Report the decision, the predicted TC of each option
